t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Stick with the same general colour scheme of gnome until it starts producing fewer mushrooms.

vb_textbox.text: The gnomes fall into two categories:Red / pink / purple / brown (these will show the RED basket)Yellow / orange / green / blue (these will show the YELLOW basket)Each category will do very well for a while (3+ mushrooms), and then will start doing badly (0-2 mushrooms).Both categories might do well at the same time, or both categories might do badly at the same time, but once a category starts doing well, you should stick with that category for a while. Once you get 0 or 1 mushrooms, try the other category - though note that even while doing well, you might get 0 mushrooms one time, and then immediately start doing well again. Perhaps use the 1x rounds to 'test' the other category to see how it's doing.
